summary: Accept standard ASCII short and qualified hostnames through shared GUI/backend validation. API impact: none, local installer input only.

guide.reason: Qualified names and standards-based limits change accepted input and installed short/full hostname behavior.

api.reason: Existing protected local installer settings are consumed by Debian; no Controller/Core or client API contract is added or changed.

verification.method: Standards review, compiled boundary tests, backend generated configuration checks and native GUI walkthrough; exact results in QA report.
